full_design_verbatim:
Candidate dispatch design — FIRST shaping only, 2026-11-05; no adoption or execution clearance.

Outcome and lineage. Preserve the complete original description and original three acceptance criteria. Complete BOTH R-GP-IMPL-FIXTURE-PID-SWEEP-3 N12 and N13 from PR509 round3, not a fixture-only, script-only, comment-only or documentary substitute: the two F5 cases execute successfully with unreadable PID namespace, and leak_by_file.py validates its scratch root before any directory mutation. The retained raw verdict is CONFIRM WITH EXCEPTIONS at a6be88169abd9287de0fe181f83d36d61983cd34; its dispositions assign both notes to this child. Those are historical review facts, not current proof. Baseline inspected: clean agent/syzygy-bpyt.4 at 5110a4901e2bff68864adbc57233e0c774b3fb27. No source repair has been made. Status remains OPEN. Keep title, type, priority, labels, owner, lineage, parent syzygy-bpyt.4 and its parent-child edge unchanged; no new decomposition or inferred dependency.

Governing intent and limits. Primary implementation base: CAPABILITY-1-IMPLEMENTATION-AUTHORIZATION-ACT.md authorizes code/tests/developer tooling and explicitly authorized worker workflows; THREE-SURFACE-POC-MODE-DIRECTION.md extends it only where the bounded non-release experiment requires. Primary work warrant: THREE-SURFACE-POC-IMPROVEMENT-CYCLES-DIRECTION.md, “bounded repair or improvement beads derived only from recorded findings”; its other prohibitions and shared-model WIP one remain. GP-Q0 in OWNER-DIRECTION-GREENFIELD-PARITY-ANSWERS-2026-10-21.md admits implementation/test improvement work under existing acts but defines behavior preservation to exclude “a rendered byte, a wire format, a refusal string or an exit code” and says an unlisted change to what a gate accepts/refuses “stops and returns to the owner.” This proposal does not claim a new scratch refusal is editorial: unsafe legacy evidence-tool invocations intentionally gain nonzero refusal before effects; admitted private-root execution keeps its existing measurement semantics. Before implementing, record the actual scope/applicability of the existing work warrant and implementation acts to that evidence-tool correction. A confirmed finding warrants work; it is not an owner act. If existing authority is insufficient for a gate, security/privacy/retention or normative contract consequence, retain that exact consequence as Unknown/held, prepare the concrete same-bead reviewed offering before any genuine owner question, and obtain the required act before that implementation. Do not manufacture a human question about suffix choice, copying the existing helper or test plumbing. Do not edit an adopted spec/policy or infer authorization from a candidate banner. VIS-2 (“No evidence means Unknown, not success”), VIS-4 (agents may draft, never adopt shape), SEC-3 (observed code only under an explicit opt-in profile), CC-TEST-1/2/4, CC-PROV-1 and all seven CC-BAR-5 floors apply. CC-REV-1 says the author “never finally decides which classes it touches.” Class none is the original expectation, contested by default; a reviewer decides. Apply GP-Q0 differential/predicate mutants/nonblocking cycle notice if its class triggers apply. Always retain the original N12/N13 historical verdict/disposition and current evidence separately.

Owned implementation map, subject to root's fresh allocation. Exactly apps/three-surface-poc/src/fixture-directories.test.ts; docs/evidence/poc-fixture-leak-2026-10-22/leak_by_file.py; docs/evidence/poc-fixture-leak-2026-10-22/guard_probe.py; additive task-owned evidence/adapters under docs/evidence/syzygy-bpyt-4-20/ and new private OWN. The fixture production module, global setup, test-model-fixture producers, accessibility CLI, Vitest/root manifests, package/CONTRIBUTING files and shared lifetime harnesses are read-only reference surfaces. Do not add a parallel global cleanup guard or borrow unmerged code. Freeze historical raw reviews, signed bytes, old JSON/log records and their copies; publish new evidence beside them. Do not rewrite the historical four-tool record to claim five were tested then. Updating executable evidence-tool source is an explicit current successor whose new commit/digests retire any claim that the old review verifies these changed bytes; the old review remains valid for its identified old subject.

Current allocation/readiness, refresh before execution. The 2026-11-05 static capture covers 14 actual open PRs and initially 158 file incidences (160 at the end refresh after PR764 published its correction), returned file count equal to changedFiles for each PR. Set intersection and an independent nested comparison find no exact overlap with the three proposed source paths. This says nothing about unseen/unpublished writers. N12 design and runtime matrix. Leave production pidNamespace(), ownedCopyPrefix()/ownedTemplatePrefix(), ESRCH-only deletion, UID/lstat checks, symlink/file/live/legacy/foreign preservation and no-namespace early return unchanged. In the existing it.each body, give the third unread entry a distinct literal suffix, e.g. p${dead}-n${NS}-Own123, preserving the first n0 copy and template. With NS='0', three actual directory names must still exist; assert literal cardinality/distinctness as fixture hygiene if useful, while the behavior oracle remains real directory contents plus the existing readdirSync-effect recorder. Keep both exact case identities “cannot be read” (ENOENT) and “names no inode” (pid:[]), full test title and both ownership-prefix assertions. They run as it.each on every host; do not skip them, weaken the three-name expectation, remove the listings assertion, filter duplicates or relabel a skip as a pass. Existing seven sweeping tests remain skipped only when independent ownNamespace() is undefined; seven ordinary it tests and two F5 expansions then execute. On a readable namespace run all 16; on no /proc require 9 passed, 7 skipped, 0 failed, including both named F5 cases and a normal terminating process. Portable execution observer and failure recovery. Future authorized verification uses the existing integration tier, never the removed @syzygy/three-surface-poc-app project: direct local Vitest entry for fixture-directories.test.ts with --project integration, first in a normal readable-proc fixture and then with bwrap --unshare-user --unshare-pid --tmpfs /proc. Retain the actual complete argv/mount manifest, Node/Vitest/bwrap versions, private paths, full committed tree and file digests. Confirm the inner /proc/self/ns/pid is unreadable rather than infer it from requested flags. Use a task-owned outer launcher/observer with private initially empty short TMPDIR, HOME/cache and output roots, no credentials, no network/provider access and only the necessary trusted runtime/worktree mounts. Install only in the private clone from the exact lockfile/public tarball cache, offline before the DNS-free namespace preflight; no installation occurs during shaping. Source resolution must be that clone's own source exports after npm ci. Do not run the old reviewer wrapper, whose outputs/stop files append beside frozen scripts. An outer observer, distinct from the test emitter, captures stdout/stderr, JSON/test identity counts, wait status, timeout and final process/directory checks; a worker's own JSON remains a report fact unless separately captured under CC-TEST-2. It must work without reading the inner /proc. Keep exact handles for the process/namespace/session this launcher creates; use parent wait/stable handle plus verified UID/start/namespace ownership on the outer side, never pid-number or command-pattern ownership alone. Termination/recovery signals are permitted only for this future authorized private fixture and are reported, not executed in shaping. Do not depend on unmerged 4.14 or 4.17 cleanup code. A timeout, permission denial, unreadable outer identity, collection error or missing test report is not a passing portability result; retain the attempt and concrete remaining Unknown. Historical R3 printed the two failures then hung until timeout124: a future no-failure summary followed by a hang still fails completion and requires diagnosis. Fresh roots per attempt; do not keep retrying the same unchanged failure until green. Reap owned children, then verify owned entries/processes using independent outer observations; when visibility is incomplete say Unknown, never zero. Concurrent unrelated sessions/decoy roots must survive.

N13 design and precise root contract. Copy the existing private_directory(path) predicate from interrupt_probe.py (or its identical peers), with pathlib/os/tempfile imports and its existing refusal text, into leak_by_file.py; call tmp_root = private_directory(tmp_root) immediately after argument parsing and before tracked() queries, fNN mkdir/rmtree or child execution. Return the canonical resolved Path. Reject a resolved root equal to /, tempfile.gettempdir(), explicit TMPDIR (or /tmp), HOME, or an ancestor containing one of them, even if it is empty or the shared child does not exist. Reject an existing non-directory or a directory holding anything. Missing or existing-empty distinct private roots remain allowed; their fNN children are still created/removed per file and the root itself stays. Keep CLI positional order <repo-tree> <tree-commit> <scratch-tmp-root> <out.json>. Do not change admitted-run discovery, selector, count schema, nonzero-child recording, output location, deletion suffixes, timing, successful-run exit or exception propagation as incidental cleanup. The predicate resolves symlinks exactly as its peers do; it is not a new blanket symlink refusal, mode/UID validator, race-proof lease or atomic ownership protocol.
